title: Planting Together

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Ruth and I are planting the border again, together. It'll be even lovelier than before.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: This time, let's try a new pattern. I'll start it, and you carry it on.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Carry on the pattern. What comes next?

older.prompt: Carry on the pattern: red, blue, blue. What comes next?

feedback.all_good: Our border is back, more beautiful than before!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: When we forgive, something new can grow. Just like this border.

journal_line: I replanted the flower border with Miss Miriam and Mrs. Ruth, in a new pattern.
